summary: A 54-foot metal lookout above Flagstaff, built in 1977 after the Radio Fire damaged its 1926 tower; registered on the NHLR in 2001.

facts.design: Present 54-ft metal tower with a CL 100 live-in cab with catwalk (built 1977), replacing a 37-ft Aermotor tower erected in 1926

access.note: Reached by trail from downtown Flagstaff. No source read confirms whether the cab itself is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: Trail from downtown Flagstaff, per the National Historic Lookout Register

events.note: Forest Service completed a new lookout station on the highest point of Elden Mountain, with a one-room house for the ranger
37-ft Aermotor tower erected on the site
Bill Pradt's 23-year career as fire lookout on Mount Elden ended as the season closed; much fire control work ran through the lookout by radio
Radio Fire, a human-caused wildfire of 4,600 acres, burned to the crest and damaged the 1926 tower
54-ft metal tower with a CL 100 live-in cab with catwalk constructed
Registered April 1, 2001 as US 372; nominated by Dave Lorenz, Director, AZ/NM FFLA

corrections.why: The register and PeakBagging both give the present tower as 54 ft, about 16.5 m. 30.5 m is 100 ft, which matches neither.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia gives 9,301 ft (2,835 m) for the mountain's summit. The register gives 9,224 ft (2,811 m) for the lookout site. The record keeps the register's 9,224 ft (2,811 m) figure for the lookout site.

notes_for_editor: Current staffing is unconfirmed; no dated record after 1950 was read, and the register's 'active service' line dates from its 2001 registration. Access level is restricted by judgment: the trail is public, but entry to the cab is unconfirmed. HikeArizona (403 to fetch_text and WebFetch) has a search snippet saying the tower has been closed to the public since 2009. That is unverified and not used in the story; check it before publishing any access claim. The AZ Daily Sun watchtower story returned 429 and the Forest Service trailhead page does not discuss the tower. Read budget was exceeded (about 11 page attempts).
